findings.evidence: `private abbrev QuotientOfLeRadical` OrthogonalComplement.lean:63; no `@[expose]` on `quotientOfLeRadical` (:74) or `orthogonalQuotient` (OrthogonalQuotient.lean:74); the file's only exports are mk, pairing_mk, surjective, ker, eq_zero_iff.
findings.fix: Add the missing eliminators rather than exposing bodies: `quotientOfLeRadical.lift`/`orthogonalQuotient.lift` descending an `f : ↥(A.orthogonalComplement H) →+ B` that vanishes on `H.addSubgroupOf (A.orthogonalComplement H)`, with a `@[simp] lift_mk`; and a public `≃ₗ[ℤ]` from the quotient carrier onto `↥(A.orthogonalComplement H) ⧸ (H.addSubgroupOf (A.orthogonalComplement H)).toIntSubmodule` (or make `QuotientOfLeRadical` public, as `IntegralLattice.DiscriminantGroup` is at Discriminant/Group.lean:109) so `QuadraticMap.lift` is usable.
findings.issue: No elimination principle for `orthogonalQuotient` (and `quotientOfLeRadical`): the carrier abbrev `QuotientOfLeRadical` is `private` (OrthogonalComplement.lean:63) and neither def is `@[expose]`, so downstream modules cannot see the carrier is a `Submodule.Quotient` and there is no `lift`. Any map out of the quotient is therefore undefinable except by hand-rolling `Function.surjInv`. Concretely this blocks the stated next PR: `FiniteQuadraticModule` stores `quadratic : QuadraticMap ℤ toFiniteBilinearModule.carrier _` (Quadratic.lean:55), and Mathlib's `QuadraticMap.lift` (mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/QuadraticForm/Radical.lean:75) needs the carrier to be literally `M ⧸ N`.

findings.evidence: OrthogonalQuotient.lean:164-172; existing lemmas OrthogonalComplement.lean:210, OrthogonalQuotient.lean:141; `AddSubgroup.eq_of_le_of_card_ge` at mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Group/Subgroup/Finite.lean:115 (already used at OrthogonalComplement.lean:225).
findings.fix: State the characterization: for `hA : A.IsNondegenerate` and `hH : A.IsIsotropic H`, `Nat.card (A.orthogonalQuotient H) = 1 ↔ A.IsLagrangian H`. The missing direction: card 1 plus `card_orthogonalQuotient_mul_sq` gives `|H|² = |A|`, with `IsNondegenerate.card_mul_card_orthogonalComplement` gives `|H^⊥| = |H|`, then `AddSubgroup.eq_of_le_of_card_ge` with `isIsotropic_iff_le_orthogonalComplement`.
findings.issue: `IsLagrangian.card_orthogonalQuotient` gives only Lagrangian → `Nat.card = 1`. The roadmap bullet quoted in the PR description asks for "unimodular exactly when H is Lagrangian", and `IsUnimodular ↔ Nat.card DiscriminantGroup = 1` (Unimodular.lean:86), so the downstream iff cannot be assembled from this half alone.

findings.evidence: OrthogonalComplement.lean:118-123 vs OrthogonalQuotient.lean:111-115; precedent `discriminantGroup_mk_eq_zero_iff` / `discriminantGroup_mk_eq_iff` at Discriminant/Group.lean:114,121.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] quotientOfLeRadicalMk_eq_zero_iff : A.quotientOfLeRadicalMk K hK x = 0 ↔ x ∈ K` (and the `radicalQuotient` specialization) plus `orthogonalQuotientMk_eq_iff : mk x = mk y ↔ ((x - y : A.orthogonalComplement H) : A) ∈ H`.
findings.issue: Incomplete equality characterization on the new general quotient: `quotientOfLeRadical` exports `_ker` but no `quotientOfLeRadicalMk_eq_zero_iff`, while its specialization gets `orthogonalQuotientMk_eq_zero_iff`; and no `_mk_eq_iff` exists for either (`mk x = mk y ↔ x - y ∈ K`). The repo's other quotient supplies both forms.

summary: The introduction side of the new quotient API is complete and correctly annotated, but there is no elimination principle and the carrier is unreachable downstream, so no consumer can define a map out of `orthogonalQuotient` — which blocks the quadratic refinement this PR names as the next step. The Lagrangian statement also ships only one direction of the roadmap's "exactly when".
